_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading midstream service provider and own one of the nation’s premier NGL systems, connecting NGL supply in the Rocky Mountain, Permian and Mid-Continent regions with key market centers and own an extensive network of gathering, processing, fractionation, transportation and storage assets.' 'Each of our three segments are primarily fee-based, and our consolidated earnings were approximately 90% fee-based in 2022.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could affect adversely our earnings and cash flows.' (the FY2022 10-K's own words; it does not use the word cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty; ENERGY_TRANSITION's reserves and refining are out of scope (the TRGP and BKR reading): ONEOK holds no reserves of its own and refines nothing ('We may not be able to accurately estimate hydrocarbon reserves and production volumes expected to be delivered to us for a variety of reasons, including the unavailability of sufficiently detailed information and unanticipated changes in producers’ expected drilling schedules.'); its greenhouse gas risk factor: 'We may face significant costs to comply with the regulation of GHG emissions.' (text only); its climate risk factor: 'Increasing attention to ESG issues, including climate change, may impact our business.' (text only); EV and CRYPTO are out of scope: the 10-K names neither electric vehicles nor crypto (text only); GENAI is out of scope: the 10-K names no artificial intelligence (text only)

BEAR.desc: EPS -53.7%/yr (worst year FY13-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -25.1%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.5%/yr (FY13-FY22 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +64.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY13-FY22, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2023-07-21) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.25x (74.4% downside to Bear $17 / +294.0% upside to Bull $262) | Adj composite 2.80 vs market 1.67: gap +1.13 [UNDERVALUED] | -17% above the EPP floor $80 (15x FY23E $5.36) | Conservative 2-yr case: +97.2% total (+48.6%/yr) | At 12.4x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $88 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net margin +8.8% and Distribution operating income n/r in Q1 2023, forward revenues -17% (no FY23 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2023 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (CLOUD and OFFSHORE are scoped to IT, ECOMMERCE to retail, STREAMING to TV, ENERGY_TRANSITION to reserves and refining, EV to fuel retail, CRYPTO to payments and banks, GENAI to software, services and content).
